title: AgentCoop config.yaml
description: Hand-written schema for editor autocomplete / typo-checking of config.yaml. It intentionally does NOT re-validate every connector-type-specific field (server/allowed_users/attachments/agent_chain vary by connector 'type') — that stays the job of `coop config validate`. See docs/migration-0.3.md for the format this schema describes (v0.3+: connector_templates/agent_templates/watcher_templates + per-entry 'inherits:', tool_presets, watcher rooms:).

tool_presets.description: Named, reusable lists of inline tool rules. Reference a preset by name from owner_allowed_tools/guest_allowed_tools. A preset's own list may only contain inline rules (no preset-of-presets).

agent_templates.description: Named, reusable field blocks for agents. Reference one by name via an agent's 'inherits:' field (the agent's own fields win on conflict; flat one-tier merge — no nested templates).

description.description: Optional annotation for this template (informational only; never merged into entries).

connector_templates.description: Named, reusable field blocks for connectors. Reference one by name via a connector's 'inherits:' field. Must not set 'name' — that identifies a specific connector. No nested templates.

description.description: Optional annotation for this template (informational only; never merged into entries).

watcher_templates.description: Named, reusable field blocks for watcher rules. Reference one by name via a rule's 'inherits:' field. Must not set 'name' or 'room' — those identify a specific entry. 'rooms' MAY be set here: a rule's own 'rooms' deep-merges over it, so a template can supply 'direct: true' while each entry adds its own 'include'. No nested templates.

description.description: Optional annotation for this template (informational only; never merged into entries).

max_queue_depth.description: Max pending messages per room queue; 0 = unbounded.

watcher_rules.description: The watcher rules. A bare `watcher_rules:` (YAML null) is the same as an empty list, as the loaders treat it.

tool.description: Regex matched against the tool name (case-insensitive, fullmatch).

params.description: Optional regex matched against the tool's primary parameter (command / url / file_path / full JSON, depending on the tool).

toolEntry.description: Either the name of a 'tool_presets:' entry (string), or an inline tool rule (object). The two forms may be freely mixed in one list.

connector.description: additionalProperties is intentionally left open — server/allowed_users/attachments/agent_chain and other fields vary by connector 'type' (rocketchat/mattermost/voice/script) and are validated by each connector's own config parser, not by this schema.

description.description: Optional annotation for this connector (informational only; ignored at runtime).

inherits.description: Name of a 'connector_templates:' entry to deep-merge as this connector's base (this connector's own fields win on conflict).

description.description: Optional annotation for this agent (informational only; ignored at runtime).

inherits.description: Name of an 'agent_templates:' entry to deep-merge as this agent's base (this agent's own fields win on conflict). Templates cannot themselves set 'inherits'.

type.description: Required (directly or via an inherits: agent_templates entry) — no fallback.

command.description: Defaults based on 'type' when omitted ('claude' for type: claude, 'opencode' for type: opencode) — not a single fixed fallback.

working_directory.description: Required (directly or via an inherits: agent_templates entry); must exist on disk when the gateway loads.

watcher.description: A 'watchers:' entry — a watcher RULE (docs/design/dynamic-watcher-design.md §2.1). The static shape ('room:', or 'rooms:' as an array) was removed at cutover; the loader refuses it with a pointer at docs/migration-v1.md, and this schema matches that refusal rather than dual-accepting a shape nothing runs.

dmOptIn.description: Opt in to a DM class. Only true/false is accepted by the loader today. The object form is reserved for per-DM include/except_for (§2.7) and is accepted here so that adding it later extends this union instead of changing the schema's shape — a config written against the newer loader still validates against this schema.

description.description: Optional annotation for this rule (informational only; ignored at runtime).

inherits.description: Name of a 'watcher_templates:' entry to deep-merge as this rule's base (this rule's own fields win on conflict).

name.description: The rule's identity — required and unique. Unlike the static shape there is no single room to derive a name from, and this is what shadowing warnings and persisted rule_name refer to.

rooms.description: Which rooms this rule claims. Patterns govern named rooms; the DM flags govern direct messages, which have no name to match on either platform. All four may appear together.

include.description: Globs ('*', '?', '[...]') matched against the room's full name, anchored at both ends, case-sensitively. Required unless the rule opts into DMs only.

except_for.description: Evaluated after include, within this rule. An excluded room does NOT fall through to a later rule — this rule claimed it and then declined it.

session_idle_days.description: Days with no message before this watcher's runtime object is dropped (session kept) — the idle leg. Lives on the rule rather than the agent so two rules sharing an agent can differ. Independent of session_expire_days: the two legs are measured from different origins, so no ordering between them is required (both default to 15).

session_expire_days.description: Days after the watcher was DROPPED (not after its last message) before everything is reclaimed: record, backend session, prompt file, attachment workspace — the expiry leg. Measured from the drop, so an outage cannot carry a watcher from active straight to expired.

watcherRule.description: 'rooms' is not required here: a rule may take it from a 'watcher_templates:' entry via 'inherits:', and the loader reports an entry that ends up with no rooms at all.
